en: A black-and-white photograph depicting a wide, tree-lined street in a European city. The architecture features ornate, late 19th or early 20th-century buildings with steep roofs and elaborate facades. A horse-drawn carriage is visible on the street along with several pedestrians. There is what appears to be a sign with partially visible text ('rat...') on the left edge of the image.
